name: io.github.hzxwonder/dsh-codex-desktop-mcp
title: DSH Codex Desktop MCP
description: Run local Harness tasks through Chat Completions, Responses, or Anthropic Messages.

environmentVariables.name: DSH_MCP_PROTOCOL
environmentVariables.description: Wire protocol. The terminal setup command discovers models and validates the selected protocol.

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API Key for the selected provider. Pass this secret through the environment, never command arguments.

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API root. Leave empty for the selected protocol's default. Use terminal setup for model discovery.

environmentVariables.name: DSH_MCP_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model ID available to this API key. Terminal setup can discover the model list.
